title: PRPM Format Registry
description: Central registry defining all supported AI editor formats, their directory structures, file patterns, and scanning configurations

formats.description: Map of format names to their configurations

subtypes.description: Map of subtype names to their configurations

rootFiles.description: Root-level files that indicate this format (e.g., .cursorrules)

defaultSubtype.description: Default subtype to use when an unknown subtype is requested for this format

directory.description: Directory path relative to project root where packages are stored

scanDirectory.description: Directory to scan if different from install directory (e.g., Claude hooks)

filePatterns.description: Glob patterns for matching package files (e.g., *.md, *.mdc, SKILL.md)

nestedIndicator.description: File that indicates a valid package in nested mode (e.g., SKILL.md)

fileExtension.description: Default file extension for this format (e.g., .md, .mdc, .toml)

usesPackageSubdirectory.description: Whether directory path includes package name (e.g., .claude/skills/{name})
